# Use the final ADR lint follow-up as the newline evidence

Entry 2099, titled Linting fix, removes final newlines from both ADR navigation files. Entry 2101, also a lint follow-up, restores them. The records index retains removal of its extra trailing blank line. The fixed accepted .editorconfig explicitly sets insert_final_newline=true, and both current navigation files end with LF. A commit title that says lint fix is insufficient to establish a formatting rule; check the final same-scope source and its configuration. These are human-authored focused changes and remain eligible source evidence. No original linter diagnostic, formatter run, build or documentation rendering was inspected. External context is pending.

Scope: ADR Markdown final newline.
